title: Encoded PowerShell launched from Outlook
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: sysmon
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image|endswith: '\\outlook.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '-EncodedCommand'
  condition: selection
level: high
description: Detects PowerShell execution with encoded commands launched as a child process of Outlook, indicative of T1566.001 phishing attachment execution.
